title: SkillSeam: Six Principles for Auditing Agent Skill Collections
abstract: arXiv:2609.13321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A folder of competent skills is not yet a reliable system. Skills rarely fail alone; they   fail at the seams of a collection. As an agent's skill library grows, procedures compete for   attention, aliases double-load, boundaries blur, and poorly sized skills turn routing errors   into task failures. We introduce SkillSeam, a method that audits the relationships through   which individual skill files become a system. It maps each collection-level principle to a   failure mechanism, its strongest observable, and a controlled perturbation test. From one   sealed skill system, SkillSeam perturbs six design principles: persistence gradient, system   coherence, regime gating, orthogonal coverage, flow, and granularity discipline. Crucially,   each principle is evaluated through the channel its failure mechanism predicts rather than   through accuracy alone. translated_title: SkillSeam：审计智能体技能集合的六大原则
translated_abstract: 一个装满合格技能的文件夹并不等于一个可靠的系统。技能很少单独失败；它们往往在集合的接缝处失效。随着智能体技能库的增长，各个程序会争夺注意力，别名被双重加载，边界变得模糊，而大小不当的技能会将路由错误转化为任务失败。我们提出了 SkillSeam，这是一种审计单个技能文件如何通过相互关系构成一个系统的方法。它将每个集合级原则映射到一种失败机制、其最强的可观测信号以及一个受控的扰动测试。SkillSeam 以一个密封的技能系统为基础，对六项设计原则进行扰动：持久性梯度、系统一致性、状态门控、正交覆盖、流程和粒度规范。至关重要的是，每项原则都通过其失败机制所预测的通道进行评估，而非仅依据准确率。扁平化持久性层次结构会使加载技能的 token 数量增加 60%；一个悬空……（原文在此截断）
tldr: SkillSeam 提出了一种审计智能体技能集合的系统性方法，通过扰动持久性梯度、系统一致性、状态门控、正交覆盖、流程和粒度规范这六项设计原则，并依据各自的失败机制预测通道而非单纯准确率进行评估，从而揭示技能在集合接缝处的系统性失效。
en_tdlr: SkillSeam is an auditing method that reveals how agent skill collections fail at their seams by perturbing six collection-level design principles, each evaluated through the channel its failure mechanism predicts rather than through accuracy alone.
